label: PF Backlog 674
title: Review material-change decision API and correct delta-review base
body: Review budget blocks legitimate fix deltas because HIL MATERIAL_CHANGE decisions cannot be recorded through the backlog API, and re-review base selection rejects a valid earlier reviewed head. Add an operator-only decisions endpoint and make delta-budget exemption require a reviewed ancestor base plus a reason citing the latest review SHA.

objective: Review material-change decision API and correct delta-review base
acceptance_criteria: The backlog API exposes an operator-only endpoint to append a MATERIAL_CHANGE decision with mode, reason, HIL confirmation and revision guard, and the item stores it for review_budget.
Delta re-review budget exemption accepts any reviewed ancestor as --since, requires the reason to cite the latest review SHA, and rejects arbitrary caller-supplied SHAs.
Tests cover API auth/validation, decision persistence, accepted reviewed-ancestor delta, and rejection of arbitrary or non-reviewed bases.
